1.ja: ולמא ראי' אלקום. אן מוסי' קד אבטא אן ינזל מן אלגבל
1.en: And when the people saw that Moses had delayed in coming down from the mountain,
1.he: וַיַּרְא הָעָם כִּי-בֹשֵׁשׁ מֹשֶׁה לָרֶדֶת מִן-הָהָר

1.ja: קם אצנע לנא מעבודא. יסיר בין ידינא
1.en: Rise, make us an object of worship that shall go before us —
1.he: קוּם עֲשֵׂה-לָנוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר יֵלְכוּ לְפָנֵינוּ

1.ja: פאן ד'אלך אלרגל מוסי'. אלד'י אצעדנא מן בלד מצר
1.en: for that man Moses, who brought us up from the land of Egypt,
1.he: כִּי-זֶה מֹשֶׁה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלָנוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם

1.ja: לם נעלם מא כאן מן אמרה
1.en: we do not know what has become of his affair.'

2.ja: אלתי פי אד'אן נסאכם. בניכם ובנאתכם
2.en: which are in the ears of your wives, your sons, and your daughters,

3.ja: פפך גמיע אלקום. אשנאף אלדהב אלתי פי אד'אנהם
3.en: And all the people removed the earrings of gold which were in their ears,
3.he: וַיִּתְפָּרְקוּ כָּל-הָעָם אֶת-נִזְמֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר בְּאָזְנֵיהֶם

4.en: And he took that from them,
and ordered one to shape it with a mold,
and made it into a molten calf.
This is your lord, O house of Israel,
who brought you up from the land of Egypt.'

5.en: he built an altar before it,
and called out and said: 'A festival to God tomorrow.'
5.he: וַיִּקְרָא אַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמַר חַג לַיהוָה מָחָר

6.en: And they rose early in the morning,
and the people sat down to eat and to drink,

7.en: whom you brought up from the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves.'

8.ja: זאלו סריעא. ען אלטריק אלד'י אמרתהם בה
8.en: 'They have turned aside swiftly from the way which I commanded them;
and they made themselves a molten calf,
and bowed down to it and slaughtered to it,

8.ja: הד'א רבך יא אל אסראיל. אלד'י אצעדך מן בלד מצר
8.en: This is your lord, O house of Israel, who brought you up from the land of Egypt.'
8.he: אֵלֶּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלוּךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם

10.en: 'And now, if you refrain from interceding,
My anger shall intensify against them and I shall destroy them;
and I will make of you a great nation.'

11.en: And Moses supplicated before God his Lord,

11.ja: וקאל יא רב. לא ישתד ג'צ'בך עלי' קומך
11.en: and said: 'O Lord, let not Your anger intensify against Your people,
11.he: וַיֹּאמֶר לָמָה יְהוָה יֶחֱרֶה אַפְּךָ בְּעַמֶּךָ

11.en: whom You brought out from the land of Egypt
with great power and with a mighty hand —'

12.ja: אנה אכ'רגהם בשר ליקתלהם פי מא בין אלגבאל
12.en: that He brought them out with evil intent, to kill them amid the mountains
and to destroy them from the face of the earth.
Turn back from the fierceness of Your anger,
and pardon the affliction for Your people.'

13.en: 'And remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, Your servants,
to whom You swore by Your name,

13.ja: וקלת להם. אכת'ר נסלכם. ככואכב אלסמא
13.en: and said to them: I will multiply your offspring like the stars of the sky;
13.he: וַתְּדַבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם אַרְבֶּה אֶת-זַרְעֲכֶם כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם

13.ja: וגמיע אלבלד אלד'י אקסמת. אעטיה לנסלכם
13.en: and all the land which I have sworn I will give to your offspring,
13.he: וְכָל-הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתִּי אֶתֵּן לְזַרְעֲכֶם

13.en: and they shall possess it forever.'

14.en: which He had said He would bring upon His people.

15.ja: ת'ם ולא מוסי' ונזל מן אלגבל
15.en: Then Moses turned and descended from the mountain,
with the two tablets of the testimony in his hand —

15.ja: לוחין מכתובין מן גאנביהמא. מן דאכ'ל ומן כ'ארג
15.en: the tablets written on both their sides, from within and from without.
15.he: לֻחֹת כְּתֻבִים מִשְּׁנֵי עֶבְרֵיהֶם--מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה הֵם כְּתֻבִים

16.en: And the two tablets — they were the workmanship of God,
and the writing was the writing of God,

17.ja: פסמע יהושע. צות אלקום פי תגליבהם
17.en: And Joshua heard the sound of the people in their clamor,
'There is a sound of war in the camp.'

18.ja: ליס הו צות ידל עלי' צ'פר
18.en: 'It is not a sound that indicates victory,
nor a sound that indicates defeat —
rather, it is a tumult that I am hearing.'

19.en: And when he drew near to the camp,
he saw the calf and the drums;
and he threw the tablets from his hands
and shattered them at the foot of the mountain.

20.ja: פאכ'ד' אלעגל אלד'י צנעו ואחרקה באלנאר
20.en: And he took the calf which they had made, and burned it with fire,
20.he: וַיִּקַּח אֶת-הָעֵגֶל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ וַיִּשְׂרֹף בָּאֵשׁ

20.en: and ground it with the file until it was fine;
and he scattered it upon the face of the water,
and made the sons of Israel drink it freely.

21.en: 'What did these people do to you,
that you brought upon them a great sin?'

22.en: that they are prone to evil.'

23.ja: פקאלו לי אצנע לנא מעבודא. יסיר בין ידינא
23.en: 'They said to me: Make us an object of worship that shall go before us —
23.he: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לִי--עֲשֵׂה-לָנוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר יֵלְכוּ לְפָנֵינוּ

23.ja: פאן ד'אלך אלרגל מוסי'. אלד'י אצעדנא מן בלד מצר
23.en: for that man Moses, who brought us up from the land of Egypt,
23.he: כִּי-זֶה מֹשֶׁה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלָנוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם

23.ja: לם נעלם מא כאן מן אמרה
23.en: we do not know what has become of his affair.'

24.en: 'So I said to them: Look, who has gold?
bring it to me. And they removed it and gave it to me,
and I threw it into the fire,

25.ja: פלמא ראי מוסי אלקום. אנהם מכשופין
25.en: And when Moses saw the people — that they were exposed,
25.he: וַיַּרְא מֹשֶׁה אֶת-הָעָם כִּי פָרֻעַ הוּא

25.ja: אד' כשף הרון. ד'וי אלשין מן מקאומיהם
25.en: since Aaron had laid bare those of standing among their adversaries —

26.en: Moses stood at the gate of the camp,
and said: 'Who is for God — let him come to me.'
And all the sons of Levi gathered to him.

27.en: 'Thus says God, the God of Israel:
Let every man among you gird his sword,

27.ja: ואמצ'ו וארגעו. מן באב אלי' באב פי אלעסכר
27.en: and go and return from gate to gate within the camp,

27.ja: ויקתל כל רגל. חתי' אכ'יה וצאחבה וקריבה
27.en: and let every man slay even his brother and his companion and his kinsman.'
27.he: וְהִרְגוּ אִישׁ-אֶת-אָחִיו וְאִישׁ אֶת-רֵעֵהוּ וְאִישׁ אֶת-קְרֹבוֹ

28.ja: פצנעו בני לוי כמא אמרהם מוסי'
28.en: And the sons of Levi did as Moses had commanded them;

28.ja: פוקע מן אלקום פי ד'אלך אליום. שביה בת'לאת'ה' אלאף רגל
28.en: and there fell of the people on that day approximately three thousand men.
28.he: וַיִּפֹּל מִן-הָעָם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אַלְפֵי אִישׁ

29.en: every man even against his son and his brother —
and may there come upon you today a blessing.'

30.en: And it was on the morrow,
And now I will go up to God —
perhaps I may seek forgiveness for your sin.'

31.ja: יא רב. קד אכ'טא הולאי אלקום כ'טייה ]עט'ימה] עצ'ימה
31.en: 'O Lord, these people have indeed committed a great sin,
31.he: אָנָּא חָטָא הָעָם הַזֶּה חֲטָאָה גְדֹלָה

31.en: and made for themselves an object of worship of gold.'

32.en: 'And now, if You will forgive their sin —

32.ja: ואלא פאמחיני. מן דיואנך אלד'י כתבתה פאסתריח
32.en: and if not, then erase me from Your register which You have written, and I shall have rest.'

33.ja: אלד'י אכ'טא לי. אמחוה מן דיואני
33.en: 'Whoever has sinned against Me — him I shall erase from My register.'

34.en: to the place of which I told you.
Behold, My angel shall go before you;
and on the day of My reckoning, I shall call them to account for their sins.'

35.en: And God struck among the people
on account of what they had done — the calf
